subject: SummitBank MAP: security gate remediation & DPA redline
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Lowe <sam.lowe@summitbank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-08T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: SummitBank MAP kickoff — SOC 2 / DPA items and proposed timeline

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our conversation, I pulled together the initial mutual action plan items that will unblock a Q4 go/no-go for SummitBank. Top items we agreed to track here:

- SOC 2 report delivery window (we can provide our Type II, expecting final report by 11/10)
- SIG/CAIQ evidence intake and responses (audit pre-check scheduled w/TrustAudits)
- DPA redline: Summit legal to return a single consolidated redline; our suggested positions attached
- Data retention & residency: clarify retention windows for test vs. prod data; propose 90/365 split

Two asks from our side to keep the MAP tight:
1) Can Summit confirm the procurement review deadline (you mentioned 10/20)?
2) Please share the minimal SIG questionnaire subset you want completed before the production trial.

I attached a short SOC2 executive summary and the DPA redline v3 for your legal team to review. If those look OK I’ll loop in Aisha from TrustAudits to schedule the evidence intake.

Proposed next milestone: have DPA agreed in principle + SOC2 ETA by 10/20 so we can plan a Nov pilot.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0192
redwoodinference.com

Attachments: SOC2-exec-summary.pdf (summary), DPA-redline-v3.docx (redline)

From: Samuel Lowe <sam.lowe@summitbank.com>

Cc: Procurement <procure@summitbank.com>
Date: 2025-10-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SummitBank MAP kickoff — SOC 2 / DPA items and proposed timeline

Dylan —

Appreciate the clear summary. A few notes from Summit legal and procurement:

- Procurement confirms target internal approval by 2025-10-20, but legal may need up to two weeks after that for the final signatures.
- Legal will return a consolidated DPA redline by 2025-10-14 (they asked for a brief call to discuss two carve-outs).
- For SIG/CAIQ we want just the top 20 control families answered prior to pilot. Full intake can happen during the pilot.
- Data residency: production must be US-only; for evaluation we can accept EU-hosted sandbox if data is anonymized.

Sam

Heads up — forwarding Sam's reply. A couple of internal notes:

- SOC 2: our Type II will be complete 2025-11-08 (final cert). We can provide interim controls mapping + SOC2-exec-summary this week.
- DPA carve-outs: likely negotiation points: subprocessors list, liability cap, and EU data transfer clause. Laura — can you prep our standard fallback language and a one-pager justification for the liability cap?
- SIG subset: we can commit to the top 20 as a prioritized intake; recommend we pre-fill sections where we have standard artifacts to speed legal review.

I'll coordinate with infra to confirm the sandbox residency options (anonymized EU sandbox vs. US staging).

- Marcus

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Lowe <sam.lowe@summitbank.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procure@summitbank.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <thirdparty-audit@trustaudits.com>
Date: 2025-10-09T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SummitBank MAP kickoff — SOC 2 / DPA items and proposed timeline

Sam / Team —

Thanks for the timeline clarity. Attached is our DPA redline v3 with comments on the carve-outs you mentioned. Quick summary of our positions:

- Subprocessors: we will provide a current list and commit to 30 days notice for new subprocessors; we propose a mutual carve-out for emergent infra providers with notification.
- Liability cap: our standard is 2x the prior 12 months' fees; we can discuss a fixed cap tied to the pilot scope if that helps procurement.
- EU transfers: for production we propose standard SCCs and a US-only production topology; sandbox can be EU if data is sanitized.

Aisha — can you confirm available dates for a SIG evidence intake workshop next week? We want to prioritize the top 20 families Sam flagged.

Next steps / asks from Summit:
1) Procurement: confirm whether the 10/20 approval is signing-ready or approval-to-send-to-legal.
2) Legal: please call out any mandatory DPA clauses you cannot accept so we can surface them earlier.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference — Legal

Attachment: DPA-redline-v3.docx

From: Samuel Lowe <sam.lowe@summitbank.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <thirdparty-audit@trustaudits.com>, Procurement <procure@summitbank.com>
Date: 2025-10-10T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SummitBank MAP kickoff — SOC 2 / DPA items and proposed timeline

Laura / Dylan —

Thanks for the redline and the clear list. Quick confirmations from our side:

- Procurement: the 10/20 date is approval-to-send-to-legal. Final signatures target 11/03 pending legal review.
- Legal: they are fine with the 30-day subprocessor notice but want stronger language around data deletion on termination (they will provide clause suggestion by 10/14).
- SIG intake: Aisha, please schedule a 1.5-hour intake with our platform security team; target 10/13 or 10/14 morning CT.

We can accept the SOC2-exec-summary as interim evidence for procurement, and SummitBank commits to the pilot start (limited production traffic) once DPA sanity checks are agreed in principle.

Sam
Samuel Lowe
Head of Platform Risk, SummitBank
